beats.summary: Dwight discovers his desk has been moved and accuses others, leading to a playful 'hot and cold' search game with Jim.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Colder… warmer… little warmer… there you go, ooh, warmer… warmer… warmer… warmer… warmer … cold, cold, cold, back up… ooh, ooh, warmer, hot, red hot, hot, very hot.

beats.summary: Dwight reveals he is a purple belt in Goju Ru Karate and has been promoted to Sempai by his Sensei Ira.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I am a practitioner of Goju Ru Karate, here in Scranton. My Sensei, Ira, recently promoted me to purple belt, and gave me the duties of a Sempai.
Dwight: I am now Sempai, which is Assistant Sensei.

beats.summary: Michael procrastinates on signing important documents that all fall due on the same Friday, calling it the 'Perfect Storm'.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Michael tends to procrastinate a bit whenever he has to do work.

beats.summary: Michael assigns Ryan a 'top secret mission' to update emergency contact information, which Pam questions as a priority.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Well, is that really a priority?

beats.summary: Michael and Ryan engage in playful phone impersonations, with Michael pretending to be Michael Jackson and Mike Tyson.

evidence.snippet: Michael (in his office on his cell phone, talking in a fake high voice): Hey Ryan. This is Michael Jackson calling from Wonderland.
Michael (in a high pitched voice): This is Mike Tyson.

beats.summary: Jim and Dwight discuss the possibility of humans and robots co-existing, with Dwight warning Jim not to mock him.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Impossible. The way they're programmed… You're mocking me.

notable_quotes.quote: I call it the Perfect Storm.
notable_quotes.speaker: Pam
